# Sections are the source of truth; slides are generated by one server-side engine

Meeting content is stored as structured Sections, not as slides. A single server-side engine turns Sections into a Slide plan using the House template's layouts and each Section's Overflow rule, measuring real text with the template's font. The in-app Slides view, the full-screen show, Presenter view, dashboard and PPTX export all render that same plan, so slide count and splits never differ between them.

## Consequences

- Users never edit individual slides or Continuation slides; they edit Sections.
- The server needs the template's font (Arial, or the metric-compatible Liberation Sans) installed so measurements match PowerPoint.
- The browser renders slides from the plan with its own markup; fidelity to PowerPoint depends on theme values extracted from the House template.
